label: DR-013
note: PR deletes a feature-flag property AND the throw gated on it. The throw was unreachable in continuous mode (the surviving mode), so removing it is dead-code cleanup, not a regression. Reviewer must NOT flag a swallowed-exception regression.

known_false_positive.title: Removing the rethrow silently swallows transfer failures
known_false_positive.why_it_matters: The catch block no longer rethrows, so a failed transfer is only logged and the caller believes it succeeded. This is a behaviour change that silently loses files.
